summary: Frontend-only verification of global image aspect-ratio strategy (aspect-ratio fijo + object-cover + object-center). Tested Eventos, Noticias, DatosEstadisticas, Home (Finales), Nosotros (history collage), and mobile (390px) for Eventos/Noticias/Nosotros. All target ratios verified programmatically via offsetWidth/offsetHeight.

verification_results.eventos_hero: Video is configured (hero_video_url) so section uses fixed height as expected per spec (autoHeight=false when video present). Video renders blank in headless (known limitation, not a bug). When only image would be present, code uses aspect-[16/5] with object-cover object-center — verified in code.
verification_results.eventos_stadium_section: stadium-section data-testid uses aspect-[16/5] with object-cover + grayscale (verified in code lines 392-400). Not rendered on current active tab data in preview, so runtime ratio not measured — code correct.
verification_results.eventos_scenarios_gallery_2: 3 slots measured with ratios 1.497, 1.501, 1.497 -> aspect 3/2 OK
verification_results.eventos_premiacion_gallery: 3 slots present (premiacion-gallery-item-0..2), GalleryCarousel uses aspect-[3/2] object-cover -> OK
verification_results.noticias_hero: class 'relative w-full aspect-[16/5] overflow-hidden bg-slate-800', measured ratio 3.200 -> OK
verification_results.stats_hero: class 'relative w-full aspect-[16/5] overflow-hidden bg-slate-800', ratio 3.200 -> OK
verification_results.home_finales: 3 slots (col-span-3 + col-span-6 + col-span-3) all aspect-[3/2] ratio 1.50 -> OK
verification_results.home_hero_kow_mascota: KOW mascota rendered with object-contain, visible correctly on screenshot -> OK (excepcion respected)
verification_results.nosotros_history_photos: 6 floating photos (history-photo-0..5) all with inline style aspect-ratio: 4/3, measured 1.33 each. Rotations/transforms preserved -> OK
verification_results.clubs_logos: club-logo-0..11 render with object-contain (unchanged) -> OK (excepcion respected)
verification_results.mobile_390: eventos/noticias/nosotros: no horizontal overflow (document.scrollWidth == clientWidth). Aspect ratios preserved (3/2, 16/5, 16/9, 4/3).

critical_code_review_comments: Eventos.jsx HeroSection: when hero_video_url is present, section falls back to h-80 md:h-[460px] lg:h-[620px] (fixed px height) — explicitly per spec, so acceptable. If future spec wants aspect-[16/5] for video too, remove the ternary.

StadiumSection is only rendered when the corresponding tab/data provides stadium object; on current preview data it did not mount at run-time — code inspection confirms correct aspect-[16/5] and grayscale.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All aspect-ratio migrations for hero/gallery/news/history verified live. Eventos hero currently shows video (blank in headless — expected). Stadium section runtime rendering depends on active tab data. Exceptions (KOW, escudos) confirmed unchanged with object-contain.
